title: What It Takes: Johnny Cash (4/4)
summaryZh: 強尼‧凱許回憶他如何爭取到錄音機會，並組成樂團錄下第一批歌曲。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — What It Takes

sentences.text: You know, I had to take the chance.
sentences.zh: 你知道嗎，我一定得賭這一把。

sentences.text: He was either going to let me come in or he was going to run me off, turn me down again.
sentences.zh: 他要嘛讓我進去，要嘛就把我趕走、再拒絕我一次。

sentences.text: But evidently, he woke up on the right sit-up side of bed that morning.
sentences.zh: 但顯然那天早上他起床時心情不錯。

sentences.text: He said, Come back tomorrow and bring some musicians.
sentences.zh: 他說：明天再來，帶幾個樂手一起來。

sentences.text: So I went down to a garage where I worked, where my brother Roy worked, and was introduced to two musicians down there.
sentences.zh: 於是我到我工作的那家修車廠，也就是我哥哥 Roy 上班的地方，在那裡認識了兩位樂手。

sentences.text: Brought them back to the studio, and the next day was our first session.
sentences.zh: 我把他們帶回錄音室，隔天就是我們第一次錄音。

sentences.text: We recorded and released the songs that we recorded the second day.
sentences.zh: 我們錄了音，也把第二天錄的那些歌發行了。

sentences.text: I keep a close watch on this heart of mine.
sentences.zh: 我緊緊看守著自己這顆心。

sentences.text: I keep my eyes wide open all the time.
sentences.zh: 我隨時都把眼睛睜得大大的。

sentences.text: I keep the ends out for the tie that binds.
sentences.zh: 我守住那份把彼此繫在一起的牽絆。

sentences.text: Did you ever sense back, sitting on Sam Phillips' doorstep, that you would one day be a Household World?
sentences.zh: 當年坐在 Sam Phillips 家門口台階上的時候，你有沒有預感自己有一天會家喻戶曉？
